Alongside the news, the band has announced a national hiatus tour in May-June 2025. For this hiatus tour, HOLY HOLY promises a setlist featuring songs spanning over a decade of their work, along with a lineup of special guests. As to whether the band will perform again in the future, the answer is uncertain. "For now, having a break and getting lost in other projects is what feels right.
